title: Robo Janitor asset update
author: freemytaco69
selftext: Was able to update all the assets for my videogame using Dzine.AI IMG 2 IMG and updating them in After Effects etc. Color match and structure match do wonders!

comments.author: freemytaco69
comments.body: Link here if you want to try it out: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tacogames.ROBOJANITOR

comments.author: WillowKisz
comments.body: You have workflow for the creation of these nice assets?

replies.author: freemytaco69
replies.body: Dalle-3 -> crop or remove background with after effects -> Dzine.ai (pixel art style)

replies.author: DreamNotDeferred
replies.body: Thanks for that info. More specific question: for the main character's movement animation, where his head bobs up and down, are the frames so generated, too, or did you do those manually? If generated, could you say how you were able to generate animations/frames? Thanks for any help.

replies.author: freemytaco69
replies.body: Animation was all done manually using After Effects. Same goes for all the polishing of the assets.

replies.author: DreamNotDeferred
replies.body: Ah, ok. Never used AE, thanks.

replies.author: Epetaizana
replies.body: Once you've created your animation in AE, what output options or plugins are you using to turn the animation into a sprite/animated asset for the game?

replies.author: freemytaco69
replies.body: I just exported as a PNG sequence. I know a Sprite sheet would be more resourceful but for this game that's how I managed it.
